summary.en: Salvadoran troops have begun airstrikes and ground assaults against Haitian gang leaders, killing gang members and losing two soldiers who died handling explosives. Haitian police raids in Port-au-Prince have also eliminated suspected gang members, while a market near the capital was attacked, leaving ten dead and seven injured. The UN chief condemned a recent attack that killed 47 civilians, and the EU imposed sanctions on four Haitian gangs for serious human rights violations. Bukele shared details on the deaths of El Salvador’s troops in Haiti. The conflict produced 193 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Salvadoranske tropper har begynt luftangrep og bakkekamp mot haitiske gjengledere, drept gjengmedlemmer og mistet to soldater som døde mens de håndterte eksplosiver. Haitisk politi har også gjennomført razziaer i Port-au-Prince som har eliminert mistenkte gjengmedlemmer, mens et marked i nærheten av hovedstaden ble angrepet, noe som førte til ti døde og syv sårede. FN-sjefen fordømte et nylig angrep som drepte 47 sivile, og EU innførte sanksjoner mot fire haitiske gjenger for alvorlige brudd på menneskerettighetene. Bukele delte detaljer om dødsfallene blant El Salvadors tropper i Haiti. Konflikten førte til 193 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Haitian conflict
background.extract: Since 2020, Haiti's capital Port-au-Prince has been the site of an ongoing armed conflict between rival gangs and the state. The government of Haiti and national security forces have struggled to maintain their control of Port-au-Prince amid this conflict, with gangs speculated to control up to 90% of the city by 2023. In response to the escalating fighting, an armed vigilante movement, known as bwa kale, also emerged, with the purpose of fighting the gangs. On 2 October 2023, United Nations Security Council Resolution 2699 was approved, authorizing a Kenya-led "multinational security support mission" to Haiti. Until 2024, the war was between two major groups and their allies: the Revolutionary Forces of the G9 Family and Allies and the G-Pèp. However, in February 2024 the two rival groups united in a coalition known as Viv Ansanm, formed to oppose the government and the UN mission.
